sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Best guide and build for Aalto from WW (Wuthering Waves). Aalto is a 4 ★ rarity character from the Aero element who uses the Pistols type weapon.
 Aalto is an enigmatic Information Broker, known for his elusive nature and welcoming smile. Rumor has it he'll provide any information at the right price.

 To learn more about Aalto check the sections below. Use the tabs to quickly switch to the kind of information you're looking for.

sections.heading: Basic Attack
sections.text: Aalto fires up to 5 consecutive shots, dealing Aero DMG . Basic Attack 4 will spread the "Mist" forward, which lasts for 1.5s.

sections.heading: Heavy Attack
sections.text: Aalto enters the aiming state for a more powerful shot. The aimed shot fired after charging finishes deals Aero DMG.

sections.heading: Mid-air Attack
sections.text: Aalto consumes Stamina to perform consecutive shots at the target in mid-air, dealing Aero DMG.

sections.heading: Dodge Counter
sections.text:
Use Basic Attack after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Aero DMG.

sections.heading: Mist Avatar
sections.text: Casts "Mist" and 1 "Mist Avatar(s)" to taunt the surrounding targets. The avatars inherit a portion of Aalto's HP and generate 6 Mist Bullets around them, dealing Aero DMG .

sections.heading: Pros
Cons
Review
sections.text:
Aalto is a DPS character who is very unique - also playable as a Hybrid buffer, he creates misty gates that empower his attacks when he shoots through them. Able to jump through them to turn incorporeal to increase his movement speed, he can create mist clones to taunt nearby enemies and effectively endorse the role of a trickster, who can deal damage while distracting enemies to prevent himself from being interrupted as he attacks.
 Able to buff Aero damage dealers via his Outro skill, he was originally perceived to work exclusively as a hybrid character. However, that is not the case — while this role is suitable for him, it is currently subpar in the meta, very much outshined in Jiyan teams by Mortefi, a hybrid who is not only stronger but featured on every banner along with Jiyan, as the heavy attack amplifier was designed with the heavy attack-focused DPS in mind.
 Suffering from this constant comparison makes Aalto seem like a totally outclassed character; however, if you truly harness his damage potential and invest into him like a Main DPS, as it turns out, he is able to fully clear the tower’s endgame content if you wish to master his kit.
 The main part of his DPS potential is acquired through his mid-air attacks, the pistol shots that he fires after jumping into the air and pressing the attack button. Typically totaling between 8 and 10 pistol shots, those effective ranged bursts of damage, that receive buffed damage when shooting through gates generated by his Ultimate, give Aalto a niche as a Main DPS carry, while not being near the best in his role. He falls short not only from a damage standpoint, but from an energy regen standpoint, as Aalto has a hefty 150 energy cost on his Ultimate, which can prove very tricky to acquire.
 On top of this, the necessity to shoot through specific areas to deal extra damage, and the need to time jumps in order to make the most of his aerial attacks make him decently difficult to play and learn, as his unusual kit can prove very difficult to get used to.
 In spite of all those flaws, however, it remains enough to clear the endgame content if you wish to master his kit.
 In summary: Aalto is a subpar but viable DPS and Hybrid option, outclassed by stronger characters while still remaining usable if you play him well.

sections.heading: Best Weapons
sections.text:
The percentages show the performance of the weapon based on calculations , but in some cases, some weapons might provide additional QOL that can't be quantified and it would push that weapon ahead of others in the priority (and in those cases, we would put that weapon higher).

 102.60%

 The Last Dance (R 1 )

 The best weapon for most DPS Pistol characters, Carlotta's Signature is fantastic it provides lots of ATK, CRIT DMG and Skill DMG Bonus, which are good stats overall that Aalto can use well (although the Skill DMG isn't ideal, it's still acceptable).
 101.00%

 Woodland Aria (R 1 )

 Simple ATK and CRIT Rate stat-stick for Aalto, who does not benefit from this weapon's effects triggered upon applying Aero Erosion.
 100.00%

 Static Mist (R 1 )

 Best weapon for Hybrid Aalto. Static Mist is a fantastic weapon for Pistol buffers since it provides an ATK% buff to the next character who Intros into the field making it give an extra buff to the Moonlit Clouds Echo set; additionally it provides high Base ATK & CRIT Rate for good personal damage and provides Energy Regen to alleviate Energy costs. Fantastic weapon for buffing characters overall.
 85.50%

 Relativistic Jet (R 5 )

 This weapon is a good 4-star for characters who need extra Energy thanks to its passive which restores some; however while this is the case for Hybrid Aalto, DPS Aalto tends to not need Energy Regen which causes this weapon's effectiveness to dwindle.
 80.40%

 Undying Flame (R 5 )

 ATK and Skill DMG stat-stick, pretty simple weapon overall and not too effective for Aalto as a result of its low base stats from being 4-star.
 79.10%

 Thunderbolt (R 5 )

 Due to this Battle Pass exclusive's low base ATK and Skill DMG-focused effect, its performance isn't as strong as some other available 4-stars but it remains usable.
 78.00%

 Solar Flame (R 5 )

 This Battle Pass exclusive displays low performance in spite of its CRIT Rate secondary stat and universal ATK% boost because of its lower Base ATK and unusable Heavy ATK DMG-increasing effect; remember having CRIT as a secondary stat doesn't automatically make a weapon good.
 77.10%

 Romance in Farewell (R 5 )

 For DPS Aalto, calculated assuming the passive can get stacked up — significantly worse otherwise. A good 4-star Pistol option for DPS characters who can play in a team with Negative Statuses; the case for Aalto as he ideally wants to play alongside Ciaccona and Aero Rover, making this weapon a good 4-star alternative for him thanks to its high Base ATK compared to other 4-stars.
 76.80%

 Novaburst (R 5 )

 Alternative 4-star choice that provides extra ATK when dodging. Overall only provides ATK and nothing else making this weapon suboptimal compared to the above choices.

sections.heading: Best Echo Sets
sections.text:
1

Sierra Gale

 Offers a 10% unconditional Aero DMG% boost and an additional 30% Aero DMG% after using the intro lasting 15 seconds for a grand total of 40% additional Aero damage for most of your damage window.
 Below you can find Main Echo options:

 Nightmare: Feilian Beringal

 - Offers an unconditional 12% Aero DMG and Heavy ATK boost when used as the Main Echo, and additionally is a Summon-type echo making it easy to use in any character's rotation, which often makes it the best option for any character using the set.

 2

Windward Pilgrimage

 Only use this set with Ciaccona on the team. Best set for Aero Main DPS characters who can apply Aero Erosion or have an Aero Erosion applier on the team. Grants 10% Aero DMG Bonus and an extra 30% Aero DMG Bonus as well as 10% CRIT Rate for 10s when attacking targets inflicted with Aero Erosion. Offers an extra 10% CRIT Rate over the other Aero sets such as Gusts of Welkin or Sierra Gale, providing extra overall damage so long as Aero Erosion is present on the enemy.
 Below you can find Main Echo options:

 Nightmare: Kelpie

 - This Echo provides a free decent amount of Aero DMG when casting Outro Skill in all situations, provides 12% Aero DMG Bonus to Aalto and while its Transform Active Skill is not used in Aalto's rotations, it is the best Main Echo he has, albeit by a very small difference when compared to Reminiscence: Fleurdelys (pick what has the best substats!)

sections.heading: Special Echo Sets
sections.text:
Moonlit Clouds

 Offers a 10% unconditional Energy Regen% boost taking some pressure off your gear when aiming at ER breakpoints. Also upon using Outro, grants the next character switching in a 22.5% ATK boost, amplifying any of your main damage dealers burst windows.
 Below you can find Main Echo options:

 Impermanence Heron

 - Supportive Echo that can be run at the cost of a sizeable chunk of damage for the character who equips, trading personal gain for team benefits. Should always be used and immediately switch cancelled right before performing an Outro, leading to another DPS. When done so will grant the next character switching in 12% increased DMG% which when combined with the 5P Moonlit set which also grants 22.5% ATK% under the same conditions makes for a sizeable boost. While the echo does lower the damage of whoever wears it, it grants a massive chunk of energy on use usually saving 1 or sometimes even 2 Energy Regen sub stats that may otherwise be needed by the wearer allowing for some damage to be recovered.

sections.heading: Rotation
sections.text:
Aalto’s primary aim is to spend minimal field time while fully generating his Concerto, in order to grant another character a powerful 23% generic Aero Amplification buff with the least chance of failure. Due to his trickster build, he has many quirks and play styles available, but to best suit his endgame role, we have settled on the fastest and most consistent Concerto rotation. Presented below is some information on how to play Aalto and how his rotation works:
 His Resonance Skill: Mist Avatar, generates absurd amounts of Concerto Energy along with decent Resonance Energy and taunts the enemies with a Mist Clone.

 The quickest and most efficient method to generate his Outro is to use his Skill twice alongside his Ultimate and sequence of Basic Attacks. Due to his Skill having a long cooldown of 10 seconds at S0, longer than any rotation he would want to employ itself, it is best to weave in his skill into rotation of your other support characters to refresh its cooldown, thus allowing you to use it again for his main Concerto rotation.

 His Forte Skill: Mistcloak Dash, is an excellent but difficult to use mobility tool in actual combat situations, more so when attempting to generate Concerto quickly under pressure. Given this issue and challenge of generating Forte Gauge charges to begin with, we have opted for no Forte rotation and found it working the best, however feel free to weave in this Forte where you find it to be effective if given a chance!

 His Resonance Skill : Mist Avatar, requires a target to generate most of its Concerto and Resonance Energy and features a slight delay in their gain due to bullets needing to hit the target first. This can lead to delay in Outro and as such should be used as early in rotation as possible.

 In the given rotation, you don’t need to worry about firing through or positioning for his Mist Gates as the same is not required to achieve the Concerto threshold for his Outro.

sections.heading: Synergies
sections.text:
Ciaccona - As a core component of all mono Aero teams, Ciaccona is the best partner for Main DPS Aalto, providing good on and off-field damage with a quick rotation, and further boosts to Aero DMG. She additionally allows Aalto to run the Windward Pilgrimage Echo set for maximum potential.
 Jiyan - While Aalto is not optimal for Jiyan teams, he can serve as a viable replacement if any higher-priority teammates are already taken in other teams thanks to his 23% Aero DMG Amplify on Outro.
 Iuno - While Aalto is not optimal for Main DPS Iuno teams, he can serve as a viable replacement if any higher-priority teammates are already taken in other teams thanks to his 23% Aero DMG Amplify on Outro.
 Rover (Aero) - Another core member of the mono Aero teams with Ciaccona, Aero Rover can Amplify Aero DMG team-wide with their Signature weapon and also increase the maximum amount of Aero Erosion stacks enemies can have inflicted to further boost Ciaccona's off-field damage. Rhis makes them one of the best partners for DPS Aalto but also amazing as a general Aero DMG Amplifying Support.
 Verina - One of the usual Healing Support options that can slot into any team. Super easy to use, provides amazing team-wide ATK% buffs and 15% DMG Amplify with one of the fastest rotations in the game. Enjoy.
 The Shorekeeper - Similar to Verina, a premium Healing Support option who can not only slot into any team, but also provide insane 12.5% Crit Rate, 25% Crit DMG, 25% ATK and 15% DMG Amplify buffs to your whole team. One of the best but also easy to use characters in the game.

 Review
 Aalto is a DPS character who is very unique - also playable as a Hybrid buffer, he creates misty gates that empower his attacks when he shoots through them. Able to jump through them to turn incorporeal to increase his movement speed, he can create mist clones to taunt nearby enemies and effectively endorse the role of a trickster, who can deal damage while distracting enemies to prevent himself from being interrupted as he attacks.
 Able to buff Aero damage dealers via his Outro skill, he was originally perceived to work exclusively as a hybrid character. However, that is not the case — while this role is suitable for him, it is currently subpar in the meta, very much outshined in Jiyan teams by Mortefi, a hybrid who is not only stronger but featured on every banner along with Jiyan, as the heavy attack amplifier was designed with the heavy attack-focused DPS in mind.
 Suffering from this constant comparison makes Aalto seem like a totally outclassed character; however, if you truly harness his damage potential and invest into him like a Main DPS, as it turns out, he is able to fully clear the tower’s endgame content if you wish to master his kit.
 The main part of his DPS potential is acquired through his mid-air attacks, the pistol shots that he fires after jumping into the air and pressing the attack button. Typically totaling between 8 and 10 pistol shots, those effective ranged bursts of damage, that receive buffed damage when shooting through gates generated by his Ultimate, give Aalto a niche as a Main DPS carry, while not being near the best in his role. He falls short not only from a damage standpoint, but from an energy regen standpoint, as Aalto has a hefty 150 energy cost on his Ultimate, which can prove very tricky to acquire.
 On top of this, the necessity to shoot through specific areas to deal extra damage, and the need to time jumps in order to make the most of his aerial attacks make him decently difficult to play and learn, as his unusual kit can prove very difficult to get used to.
 In spite of all those flaws, however, it remains enough to clear the endgame content if you wish to master his kit.
 In summary: Aalto is a subpar but viable DPS and Hybrid option, outclassed by stronger characters while still remaining usable if you play him well.

 Gameplay and teams

 Rotation
 Aalto’s primary aim is to spend minimal field time while fully generating his Concerto, in order to grant another character a powerful 23% generic Aero Amplification buff with the least chance of failure. Due to his trickster build, he has many quirks and play styles available, but to best suit his endgame role, we have settled on the fastest and most consistent Concerto rotation. Presented below is some information on how to play Aalto and how his rotation works:
 His Resonance Skill: Mist Avatar, generates absurd amounts of Concerto Energy along with decent Resonance Energy and taunts the enemies with a Mist Clone.

 The quickest and most efficient method to generate his Outro is to use his Skill twice alongside his Ultimate and sequence of Basic Attacks. Due to his Skill having a long cooldown of 10 seconds at S0, longer than any rotation he would want to employ itself, it is best to weave in his skill into rotation of your other support characters to refresh its cooldown, thus allowing you to use it again for his main Concerto rotation.

 His Forte Skill: Mistcloak Dash, is an excellent but difficult to use mobility tool in actual combat situations, more so when attempting to generate Concerto quickly under pressure. Given this issue and challenge of generating Forte Gauge charges to begin with, we have opted for no Forte rotation and found it working the best, however feel free to weave in this Forte where you find it to be effective if given a chance!

 His Resonance Skill : Mist Avatar, requires a target to generate most of its Concerto and Resonance Energy and features a slight delay in their gain due to bullets needing to hit the target first. This can lead to delay in Outro and as such should be used as early in rotation as possible.

 In the given rotation, you don’t need to worry about firing through or positioning for his Mist Gates as the same is not required to achieve the Concerto threshold for his Outro.

 Synergies
 Ciaccona - As a core component of all mono Aero teams, Ciaccona is the best partner for Main DPS Aalto, providing good on and off-field damage with a quick rotation, and further boosts to Aero DMG. She additionally allows Aalto to run the Windward Pilgrimage Echo set for maximum potential.
 Jiyan - While Aalto is not optimal for Jiyan teams, he can serve as a viable replacement if any higher-priority teammates are already taken in other teams thanks to his 23% Aero DMG Amplify on Outro.
 Iuno - While Aalto is not optimal for Main DPS Iuno teams, he can serve as a viable replacement if any higher-priority teammates are already taken in other teams thanks to his 23% Aero DMG Amplify on Outro.
 Rover (Aero) - Another core member of the mono Aero teams with Ciaccona, Aero Rover can Amplify Aero DMG team-wide with their Signature weapon and also increase the maximum amount of Aero Erosion stacks enemies can have inflicted to further boost Ciaccona's off-field damage. Rhis makes them one of the best partners for DPS Aalto but also amazing as a general Aero DMG Amplifying Support.
 Verina - One of the usual Healing Support options that can slot into any team. Super easy to use, provides amazing team-wide ATK% buffs and 15% DMG Amplify with one of the fastest rotations in the game. Enjoy.
 The Shorekeeper - Similar to Verina, a premium Healing Support option who can not only slot into any team, but also provide insane 12.5% Crit Rate, 25% Crit DMG, 25% ATK and 15% DMG Amplify buffs to your whole team. One of the best but also easy to use characters in the game.
